How to use the "Spoon Trick"
Prepare the site as directed by the manufacturer: Wash the application area on the back of your upper arm with non-moisturizing, fragrance-free soap, dry it well, and clean it with an alcohol wipe. Allow the skin to air dry completely.
Apply the sensor using the applicator, following the standard instructions.
